# Miracle Websoft - Ecommerce Growth & AI Technology Agency

## Who We Are

Miracle Websoft is an ecommerce growth and AI technology agency founded in 2015 and based in Chandigarh, India. We serve ecommerce brands, Shopify merchants, SMBs, agencies and startups in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and Europe.

The company helps businesses build Shopify stores, improve conversion rates, increase website performance, automate operations with AI, develop custom business software and maintain long-term technical partnerships.

Founder Karam Singh Mehra is a Top Rated Plus Shopify expert on Upwork with 10+ years of experience. Miracle Websoft has completed 650+ projects and delivered 15,000+ hours for global clients.

## Core Services

- **Shopify Services** - Shopify store development, Shopify Plus development, theme customization, custom features, app integration, migration, maintenance, API development and private apps.
- **CRO Services** - conversion rate optimization, user journey analysis, Microsoft Clarity review, heatmap analysis, checkout optimization, product page optimization, homepage optimization, landing page optimization and A/B testing.
- **Performance Services** - Shopify speed optimization, Core Web Vitals, PageSpeed improvements, performance audits, LCP, CLS and INP improvements.
- **AI Services** - AI business automation, AI workflow automation, OpenAI integrations, AI chatbots, AI customer support, AI internal tools, AI agents, AI website development, AI content automation and AI consulting.
- **Web Development** - business websites, ecommerce websites, custom web applications, CRM development, admin panels, client portals and API integrations.
- **White Label Development** - silent development partner for agencies and studios.
- **Referral Program** - commission program for referred Shopify and ecommerce projects.

## Primary Markets

United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and Europe.

## Industries Served

Fashion and apparel, beauty and cosmetics, health and wellness, home and furniture, food and beverage, electronics, jewelry and accessories, sports and outdoors, pet supplies, B2B and wholesale, subscription and DTC, print on demand and service businesses.
